## Podframes · seven-stage API mirror
1. Read docs/N8N.md before executing (generation spends provider credits).
2. Edit Episode settings; choose a new topic or existingSlug.
3. Bind the same Header Auth credential to all SIX HTTP Request nodes:
   Authorization: Bearer <PODFRAMES_API_TOKEN>
4. Backend web + worker must be reachable and authenticated.

script → speech → stills → video → broll → compose → render

One shared loop submits only one stage at a time. Never auto-retry paid POSTs.
No secrets included. Backend owns media, provider sessions, caches, and rendering.
